jobs.occupation: B Driver with progression to CE
jobs.description:
Do you want to become a truck driver and gradually work your way up to a CE driving licence? With our client, you will have the opportunity to learn the profession and develop your skills step by step.

As a B driver for this major logistics company, you will help ensure that food products are delivered safely and on time to customers every day. You will start by making deliveries with a van and receive guidance and training to obtain your CE driving licence.

- You drive a van as a B driver and make deliveries
- You learn the routes, customers and working methods
- You actively help with loading and unloading goods
- You check your load and ensure correct delivery
- You are in daily contact with customers and represent the company
- You follow training to progress to a CE driver position
- You accurately complete transport documents
- You work according to all safety and hygiene regulations

You will join a professional environment where you are guided step by step in your development. This is your opportunity to become a skilled truck driver with plenty of opportunities for further growth.

During the onboarding period, you will work in the warehouse in a two-shift system. If this period goes well, you will start the training and receive a contract with the company.
- Vaardigheden:
You are motivated to become a truck driver
You are open to a training programme towards obtaining your CE driving licence
You are responsible and calm in traffic
You are customer-friendly and communicate fluently
You work accurately and have a strong focus on safety

- Attesten:
You hold a valid B driving licence.

- Opleidingsvereisten:
/

- Vakkennis:
Previous experience as a driver is an advantage

- Talenkennis:
You speak and understand English well

For a company in the Waregem region, we are looking for an all-round (multi-skilled) employee. You will work in a company that processes second-hand clothing.

What does the job involve?

• You assist with the initial sorting process (on top of the sorting installation).
• You are responsible for removing and transporting the initially sorted items.
• You assist our drivers with manual unloading.

• Dynamic
• Good physical condition
• Insightful, able to work independently
• No dust allergy
• Forklift experience + certificate = a plus
• You speak French / English or Dutch fluently

Are you looking for a new challenge that will (fork)lift your spirits? Be sure to read further! 
We are looking for an experienced Forklift Driver for a company specialized in the construction and interior sector. 

What are your tasks? 

• Responsibility of operating the line
• Safely but quickly move goods on and off trucks using a forklift
• Place items in the correct storage locations and stack them securely
• Move pallets and products between the dock, warehouse, and storage areas
• Respect safety rules, wear protective equipment, and ensure a safe working environment

What do we expect from you? 

• You are a motivated candidate who is ready to pick up their new tasks quickly
• You have broad experience as a forklift driver
• You are in possession of a forklift certificate
• You have your own car
• You speak English well
• You are aware of the importance of following health and safety guidelines

Are you looking for a varied job where you can both apply your technical knowledge and carry out practical tasks?

Then be sure to apply for this operator position!

You will be working in a food company specialized in the processing and storage of a wide range of food products.

As an operator, you are responsible for the smooth running of the production process and ensure that your machines continue to operate efficiently.
You do this by:

• Correctly setting machine parameters

• Monitoring quality and making adjustments to the machine when necessary

• Assisting with machine changeovers for new products

• Independently resolving minor technical malfunctions

• Correctly replenishing supplies

• Cleaning the machines

• Consulting with technicians, packaging staff, team leaders, and others

All of this takes place in a refrigerated environment (approximately 8–10°C), working in a three-shift system, while strictly adhering to hygiene and safety regulations.

You have relevant work experience and/or a technical background (e.g. through training or education).

You take pride in keeping your machine running smoothly and in resolving minor breakdowns or blockages quickly and efficiently.

You are flexible and willing to work shifts: early/late and night.

Working in a refrigerated environment (approximately 8–10°C) does not deter you.

You are able to work independently, but you also regularly consult with colleagues to ensure a smooth production process.

You do not mind performing physical work.

You have a good command of Dutch and/or English and are able to commute independently to Dendermonde.

Forum is looking for Operators in Zottegem urgently! 
Your responsibilities:

• You will be responsible for setting up, operating, and reconfiguring production equipment on a production line.
• You will be able to work on various machines.
• You will clean the machines, equipment, and conveyor belts.
• You will be responsible for quality control.
• You will work in two shifts, Monday through Friday (6:00 AM–2:00 PM and 2:00 PM–10:00 PM).

Who are you?

• You have a technical background, either through a degree or work experience
• You have some initial experience as a technical operator
• You are motivated
• You have a consistent work history
• You speak English well

As a Junior International Account Manager, you will be responsible for developing and managing relationships with clients across international markets while identifying new business opportunities and driving growth.

Bedrijfsomschrijving

Join a dynamic and fast-growing international company where innovation, entrepreneurship, and ambition are at the heart of everything. You'll have the opportunity to build a global network, make a real impact, and accelerate your career in an inspiring environment.

Omschrijving

• Build and maintain strong relationships with existing clients.
• Develop and manage your own client portfolio.
• Identify and approach new business opportunities.
• Understand clients' needs and provide tailored solutions.
• Conduct market research and monitor industry trends.
• Negotiate commercial agreements and close deals.
• Collaborate with internal teams to ensure excellent customer satisfaction.
• Represent the company during meetings, events, and client visits.

• Bachelor's degree minimum.
• Fluent in French or Dutch, with a good command of English.
• Ambitious, energetic, and driven by results.

Position summary:
 

You are responsible for leading the plant mechanical team (Shift Mechanical Engineers, Toolroom, Utility team, Workshop Team, Process Engineers) in all the maintenance and process activities in the plant to ensure smooth operation and maintenance of high speed can making Lines and ancillaries. You will be the key person driving operational excellence programs and size changes in the plant, and also be responsible for all the mechanical safety, lean events, capital projects, energy saving, and EIP.

What are we looking for?
 
 

• 7+ years relevant experience in maintenance in high-speed manufacturing with sound maintenance management practices. 

• Experience in mechanical power presses, hydraulic equipment maintenance, printing press, handling LPG, maintenance of gas-fired ovens, boilers etc. 

• Knowledge of AutoCAD - Mechanical. 

• Experienced in TPM implementation in process industry. Good understanding of other modern lean manufacture technique - SMED, Kaizen 5S, Structured Problem Solving, Six Sigma. 

• Effective communication and problem-solving skills. 

• Ability to prioritize workload based upon the plant requirements and KPI’s. Good planning skills, coordination skill and follow-up skill 

• Comfortable communication in written and spoken English

This is a job posting intended to create a reserve pool of candidates. 

Do you have a first experience in order picking or production ?  Are you organized and punctual ?  Would you like to contribute to the medical world ?  Then this job could be a perfect fit.  Our client conducts medical research using blood and urine samples and your role will be to assemble the medical kits.

The job

• Pick the required materials following the pick lists
• Assemble the medical kits 
• Assign the packaged kits to the correct shipping order
• Handle this with great care and ensure all orders are processed accurately
You will be working from Monday to Friday: 7h30 - 15h36 or 14h00 -22h06 (with a half hour break)

 

 

• Good knowledge of English
• Relevant  experience in orderpicking or production

jobs.occupation: Sales & Marketing Manager - Agricultural Machinery - FR/DU
jobs.description:
Our client is a Belgian family-owned company with over 100 years of experience in the distribution of premium technical equipment for the agricultural sector, the green/landscaping sector, and material handling. It employees +100person, generates +150M€ of annual turnover and aims to strengthen its market position by focusing on leading-edge technology, strong partnerships with dealers, and efficient services in sales, marketing, after-sales, and financing.

Jobomschrijving

As a successful Sales & Marketing Manager - Agricultural Machinery - FR/DU, you will have the following responsibilities:

• Lead the commercial strategy: annual sales plan, margins, product mix

• Animate and guide the sales & marketing team (define priorities, coordinate & coach the team on the field) - you will be responsible of 3 areas sales manager, 3 product managers & 2 persons in the back office 

• Manage pricing strategy and negotiate with key accounts & dealer networks

• Develop business via demo machines, rental, and used equipment

• Be responsible of the company brand by owning all marketing & communication activities & ensuring their consistency: marketing materials, digital channels, campaigns, ... 
• Handle the implementation of a new CRM system
• Strengthen communication with the dealer network: newsletters, events, information sessions

• Oversee events & trade fairs: stand concept, logistics, demos, post-event analysis

• Act as main link between manufacturer & internal teams; track KPIs, market trends, bonuses

As a successful Sales & Marketing Manager - Agricultural Machinery - FR/DU, you will have the following profile:

• +5 years experiences as B2B sales leader with strong commercial development skills & ability to negotiate with wholesalers 
• Experiences with long selling cycle & technical products (agriculture, machinery, industry)
• Previous experience in people management or team coaching 
• Background or strong affinity with the agriculture sector is a plus 
• Solid experience in operational marketing 
• Comfortable in managing projects (CRM, reporting, process optimization)
• Strategical mindset coupled with the willingness to remain operational & available for the teams 
• Personal traits: entrepreneurial mindset, structured, responsible, clear communicator, low ego. 
• Languages: Fluent in French, Dutch & English

jobs.occupation: Sales Associate - Chocolate Boutique - Bruges City Centre
jobs.description:
Are you looking for an exciting opportunity in the heart of Bruges?

Do you want a job with real growth potential? Are you passionate about customer service and working with high-quality products?

Then this might be the perfect opportunity for you.

This renowned chocolate boutique, located in the historic centre of Bruges, specialises in premium Belgian chocolate and offers customers an authentic chocolate experience.

The shop is known for its wide selection of pralines, truffles, and other handcrafted chocolate delicacies, all made with passion and craftmanship.

We are currently looking for an enthusiastic and customer oriented Sales Associate to join their team.

Your daily responsibilities:

• Welcoming and assisting customers
• Replenishing stock and maintaining attractive product displays
• Handling payments and operating the cash register
• Providing information about the product range
• Performing accurate stock control and monitoring expire dates
• Maintaining a warm and welcoming attitude at all times

• Perfect English and basic Dutch, but willingness to learn
• Willingness to work weekends (1 day off during the weekend)
• Evening work: in July & August, closing time is 10 PM (maximum 11 closing shifts per month)
French, Spanish, Russian, Chinese are also languages we are looking for.

As a key member of our regional field sales organization, you will be responsible for partnering with team members to effectively respond to customers and prospective inquiries to grow our business and achieve our target.

Client Details

Our client is a global life sciences organization providing specialized research solutions to pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and healthcare companies. The company is recognized for its scientific expertise and commitment to supporting innovation across the drug development process. The client is based in Schaerbeek.

 

Description

• Prospect and identify new business opportunities using available sales tools and market intelligence.
• Develop and maintain a strong pipeline of potential clients within your assigned territory.
• Work closely with the commercial team to execute business development strategies and support customer acquisition initiatives.
• Manage customer interactions through CRM tools, ensuring accurate follow-up, pipeline management and reporting.
• Serve as the main point of contact for prospects, understanding their needs and proposing suitable solutions.
• Respond to customer enquiries in a professional and timely manner, providing information, quotations and commercial support.
• Build strong relationships with clients and internal stakeholders to ensure an excellent customer experience.
• Identify opportunities for cross-selling and upselling within existing and prospective accounts.
• Prepare commercial proposals and coordinate with internal teams to deliver tailored solutions when required.
• Deliver presentations and participate in customer meetings to promote the company's products and services.
• Represent the company at selected industry events, conferences and trade shows to expand network opportunities and generate leads.
• Contribute to the growth of the business by developing new accounts and nurturing long-term customer relationships.
 

• BS degree in biology or life sciences related fields, or equivalent level of experience.
• Proven work experience as a sales support specialist or customer support associate.
• Hands-on experience with ERP and CRM systems and proficiency with MS suite incl. Excel.
• In-depth understanding and track record of best-in-class customer services.
• Excellent communication (verbal and in writing., and proficiency in English language).
• Analytical, motivational and multitasking skills.
• Teamwork and customer relationships development capabilities.
• Willingness to travel occasionally for customer meetings and industry events.
• A second European language is a plus.

Are you looking for an active night shift job in a cold (-22°C) and stable working environment?
Then this might be your new challenge!

You will be working for a rapidly growing logistics company that distributes frozen products.

As an Order Picker, you are an indispensable link in the logistics process. You ensure that orders are prepared and shipped without errors.

- You collect frozen products using a pick list and scanner.
- You stack boxes correctly on pallets according to the instructions.

- You strictly follow safety and quality rules.

You are familiar with working with an electric pallet truck.
You can work without any problems in a frozen environment of -22°C.
You enjoy active work.
